name: ic-inline
description: Shows images inline in the Claude Code transcript, decoded by ic: /ic <file> for you, show_image for Claude

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto draws real pixels where the terminal can (kitty, Ghostty) and colored half blocks elsewhere. blocks always draws half blocks. image always draws pixels.

maxRows.title: Rows at most
maxRows.description: The tallest that a picture can be in the transcript, in terminal rows.

icPath.title: ic command
icPath.description: The ic executable to run: a name on PATH or an absolute path. It must know --emit-rgba.
